summary: More views are needed around the best spot, 4 ft 0 in right of the meter: 8 checks depend on areas the scan did not see.

reasons.message: The best spot has checks nobody can settle from this scan: ground under the battery; distance from gas equipment; distance from ac units; distance from the driveway; distance from a pool; distance from doors and windows; open space in front; headroom above.
Part of the area the checks need was not seen.
